fact: A World Bank assessment from a virtual mission of 9-27 August 2021 records that CEMAC Regulation 04/18 of 21 December 2018, in force since January 2019, governs payment services in the Central African Republic, where two mobile money offers (Orange Money, Pata Biani) run through banks.
title: République Centrafricaine : Evaluation de l'Ecosystème des Paiements Numériques pour les Programmes de Transferts Monétaires des Filets de Protection Sociale
